create_channel_option_gzip: create a gRPC channel option that sets Gzip as the default compression algorithm
create_channel_option_deflate: create a gRPC channel option that sets Deflate as the default compression algorithm
augment_metadata_with_gzip: augment gRPC metadata with Gzip compression algorithm for a request
compression_algorithm_to_metadata_gzip: convert the Gzip compression algorithm to a gRPC metadata key-value tuple
augment_metadata_no_compression: augment gRPC metadata with NoCompression identity algorithm for an uncompressed request
